    # Get the rowgroup that contains the order rows (excluding the header rowgroup)
    # The accessibility tree shows two rowgroups: first is header, second is data rows
    rowgroups = page.get_by_role('rowgroup').all()

    data_rowgroup = rowgroups[1]  # Second rowgroup is for data rows
    
    # Get all rows within the data rowgroup
    rows = data_rowgroup.get_by_role('row').all()

        view_link = row.get_by_role('link', name='View')

        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

        # Use get_by_role with filtering to find the correct table
        items_table = page.get_by_role('table').filter(has=page.get_by_text('Items Ordered')).first()
        # Get all rows in the table body (excluding header rows if any)
        item_rows = items_table.get_by_role('row').all()
        # Count the rows; adjust if there are header rows, but assume all rows are items
        num_items = len(item_rows)
        total_items += num_items
        
        # Navigate back to the orders list page
        await page.go_back()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

        if len(rowgroups) < 2:
            raise Exception('Rowgroups not found after navigation back')
        data_rowgroup = rowgroups[1]
        rows = data_rowgroup.get_by_role('row').all()
    
    # After summing, set the result
    global result
    result = str(total_items)
